# Local browser dependencies

These pinned browser builds are bundled locally; visitors do not need a CDN.

| Library | Version | Purpose | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Embla Carousel](https://www.embla-carousel.com/docs/v8/) | 8.6.0 | Centered looping album, drag and snap | MIT, `embla-LICENSE.txt` |
| [Panzoom](https://github.com/timmywil/panzoom) | 4.6.2 | In-page image/table pan and pinch zoom | MIT, `panzoom-LICENSE.txt` |

Embla's UMD build comes from its versioned npm package. Its license is from
the matching `v8.6.0` source tag. Panzoom's browser build and MIT notice come
from its versioned npm package. Project controls use the separately bundled
official Lucide icons, with their existing license notices.
